Framer AI

Framer AI helps generate and refine polished, responsive websites while keeping every result editable in Framer's design-focused site builder.

What is Framer AI?

Framer AI adds generative workflows to Framer's website design and publishing environment. Users can create pages and sections, improve copy and visuals, generate interactive components and run AI-assisted review tasks, while retaining hands-on control over layout, animation, responsiveness, CMS content and publishing.

Best for: Designers, startups and marketing teams that want fast AI-assisted site creation with strong visual control and interaction design.

Main features

  • AI-generated pages and website sections
  • AI writing and content refinement
  • AI-assisted visual generation
  • Code component generation
  • Accessibility and SEO review assistance
  • Responsive visual website editor and CMS

Use cases

  • Create a landing page from a prompt
  • Prototype a startup or product website quickly
  • Generate and refine marketing copy
  • Build interactive web components
  • Review pages for common accessibility, content and SEO issues

Who is it for?

  • web designers
  • startups
  • marketing teams
  • creative agencies
  • product teams

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription with AI credits

Starting price: USD 10 / month, billed annually for the cited Basic price

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Strong design and animation control after AI generation
  • Free plan provides a practical way to try Framer and its AI credits
  • Developer ecosystem includes plugin and server APIs

Limitations

  • A custom domain requires a paid site plan
  • AI usage is governed by credits, so heavy generation can require more capacity
  • Some collaboration, staging and enterprise controls are reserved for higher tiers

Frequently asked questions

Can I use Framer AI on the free plan?

Yes. Framer's Free plan includes an allocation of AI credits for trying AI features, although publishing to a custom domain requires a paid plan.

What is Framer's entry paid website price?

The cited pricing page lists the Basic plan from $10 per month when billed annually.

Does Framer expose developer APIs?

Yes. Framer documents plugin APIs and a Server API for programmatic workflows and integrations.
